summary: The Pan African University is the African Union's own postgraduate university, with institutes in Nigeria, Cameroon, Kenya and Algeria. The African Union Commission offers full scholarships to the young Africans it admits for master's and PhD study.
meta_description: The African Union gives full scholarships for master's and PhD study at the Pan African University's institutes. Age limits, eligibility and the call.
covers: Full scholarships from the African Union Commission for admitted master's and PhD students.
Study at institutes hosted by the University of Ibadan (Nigeria), the Universities of Yaoundé II and Buea (Cameroon), Jomo Kenyatta University (Kenya) and the University of Tlemcen (Algeria).
eligibility: Applicants from African countries and the African diaspora.
Master's: aged 25 or under for men and 28 or under for women, with at least a second-class upper bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
PhD: aged 28 or under for men and 30 or under for women, with a relevant master's degree.
how_to_apply: Watch the African Union and Pan African University sites for the call; the last one opened on 15 November and closed on 15 December 2025.
Choose a programme at one institute and check that it is taking students that year.
Apply online with certified transcripts, a passport or national ID, a CV and lecturers' recommendation letters.
Shortlisted candidates may sit a written or oral examination.
watch_out: Applications after the deadline are not considered.
Not every institute admits every year; in 2026 one institute took no new students.
The age limits are strict, so check yours against the call.

sources.title: African Union: Pan African University call for scholarship applications, 2026/2027
